title: Rotation2D: a class that keeps its invariant
hints: Store (c, s) with c² + s² = 1. Every constructor and factory must establish that; nothing else can break it, because the members are private.
fromCosSin: `const double n = std::hypot(c, s); if (n < 1e-12) return Rotation2D(); ...` and divide by n.
Composition: (c1 + i s1)(c2 + i s2) = (c1c2 − s1s2) + i(s1c2 + c1s2). The inverse is (c, −s).
angle(): std::atan2(s, c) lies in [−π, π]. Map −π to +π to get (−π, π].
